title: Skull Crystal Ball
description: A glowing neon skull wearing sparkling purple sunglasses floats inside a transparent crystal ball with blue energy lines radiating outward. The black metallic base rests on a reflective surface with spilled colorful liquid and a pair of identical sunglasses lying in front, surrounded by vibrant paint splashes against a dark cosmic background.
prompt: A glowing orange and purple neon skull wearing glittery purple sunglasses sits inside a transparent crystal ball with bright blue energy beams radiating from it like a starburst. The crystal ball has a glossy black metallic base with rivets and rests on a reflective surface with colorful paint splashes in purple, cyan and pink. Another pair of sparkling sunglasses lies in the foreground. Dark cosmic background with floating particles and dramatic lighting.
